pages.text: Red sand is in my hand.

I sit in the red sand. Nan has
a rest.

I tip some soft sand in Nan’s
big hands.

Nan and I dig a hill in the soft
sand for fun.

Red sand is on my legs. I sink
in the hot sand.

Sand on my hand, sand on my
hips, sand on my legs.

I jump up and the red sand
tips off.

Nan and I set off. Nan is the
best.
